#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long modularInverse(long long num) {
    long long power = MOD - 2;
    long long result = 1;
    long long base = num;
    while (power > 0) {
        if (power & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        power >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

struct Node {
    int c50, c100, b, n;
    long long am;
    std::vector<Node*> s;
    Node(int c50_, int c100_, int b_) : c50(c50_), c100(c100_), b(b_), n(0), am(0) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    vector<long long> factorials(51, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; i++) {
        factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }

    long long combinations[51][51];
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
        combinations[i][0] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            long long denom = (factorials[j] * factorials[i - j]) % MOD;
            long long invDenom = modularInverse(denom);
            combinations[i][j] = (factorials[i] * invDenom) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int total, maxCards;
    cin >> total >> maxCards;
    int count50 = 0, count100 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        if (val == 100) count100++;
        else count50++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<Node>>> graph(count50 + 1, vector<vector<Node>>(count100 + 1, vector<Node>(2, Node(0,0,0))));
    for (int i = 0; i <= count50; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= count100; j++) {
            graph[i][j][0] = Node(i, j, 0);
            graph[i][j][1] = Node(i, j, 1);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= count50; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= count100; j++) {
            int max50Pick = std::min(maxCards / 50, i);
            int max100Pick = std::min(maxCards / 100, j);
            for (int x = max100Pick; x >= 0; x--) {
                for (int y = std::min(max50Pick, (maxCards - 100 * x) / 50); y >= 0; y--) {
                    if (x == 0 && y == 0) continue;
                    graph[i][j][0].s.push_back(&graph[i - y][j - x][1]);
                    graph[i - y][j - x][1].s.push_back(&graph[i][j][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    queue<Node*> q;
    graph[count50][count100][0].n = 1;
    graph[count50][count100][0].am = 1;
    q.push(&graph[count50][count100][0]);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node* current = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (Node* neighbor : current->s) {
            if (neighbor->n == 0 || neighbor->n == current->n + 1) {
                long long p1, p2;
                if (current->b == 0) {
                    p1 = combinations[current->c50][abs(current->c50 - neighbor->c50)];
                    p2 = combinations[current->c100][abs(current->c100 - neighbor->c100)];
                } else {
                    p1 = combinations[count50 - current->c50][abs(current->c50 - neighbor->c50)];
                    p2 = combinations[count100 - current->c100][abs(current->c100 - neighbor->c100)];
                }
                neighbor->am = (neighbor->am + (current->am * (p1 * p2) % MOD)) % MOD;
                if (neighbor->n == 0) {
                    neighbor->n = current->n + 1;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << (graph[0][0][1].n - 1) << "\n" << graph[0][0][1].am << "\n";

    return 0;
}
